principle: Platform defaults such as density, size, and theme must come from the Flow cascade; component-level semantic default decisions may exist only when visible and contract-backed. The actionable debt metric is defaultDebt.

prohibitedRules.description: React components must not default density to sm/md/lg; density must cascade through normalizeFlowDensity.
React components must not normalize a hardcoded density literal.
React components must not emit flowDensityProps from a hardcoded density literal.
React components must not reintroduce size as a parallel density API.
React components must not default theme/colorScheme; theme must come from the system cascade.
React components must not set data-theme to a hardcoded light/dark value.
